description: Ask a RUNNING run to pause after the pass it is in: it finishes that pass, then stops before the next one starts (run_status reads it as owner_paused). The stop spends nothing; the person decides when to go on, and resume_run with only the run id continues it. Pass person_words, the person's own answer as they typed it, when the person asked for the pause; pass reason, your own, when you ask on your own account; never both, and one of them is required (a session is never the person at a terminal). Refuses a run nobody is running, a member of a tree, and a request that is already open. Nothing is recorded on a refusal.
name: pause_run
